make_artificial_society

Source: R/social.R
make_artificial_society.Rd

Creates a homophilous social influence network based on demographic attributes contained in dep_society and weights in homophily.

make_artificial_society(
  society = depmicrosimr::dep_society_1,
  homophily = depmicrosimr::homophily,
  nu = 4.5
)

Arguments

society

dataframe containing society

homophily

tibble with homophily parameters for society

nu

gower distance exponent

Value

a tidygraph object

Examples

make_artificial_society(dep_society_1,homophily,nu=4.5)
